calculation's intersections, even-sector gap, and componentwise L2 budget.

independent_integral_assembly.scope:
Independent numerical integration of CCM (3.14), (3.16), and (4.4).

Compare all entries of the C=13, N=10 matrix with analytic interval assembly.
Tanh-sinh quadrature is a numerical cross-check, not a rigorous enclosure.

fixed_matrix_precision.scope:
Round one fixed C=13,N=10 matrix, then solve each rounded problem at 220 dps.

This separates input rounding from matrix recomputation and solver precision.
Outcomes at deliberately inadequate precisions are retained as observations.

prime_response_control.scope:
Numerical centered-perturbation test of retained prime-power responses.

This is an independent high-precision experiment, not an interval certificate.
The perturbed family is A+t D_power with observation poles fixed. It does
not remove a prime and is not the full cutoff derivative.

response_decomposition.scope: Numerical source-bound channel reconciliation; the sum does not independently validate every nonprime derivative.

prime13_edge_control.scope: One-sided activation of the individual prime-13 matrix component, with all other components excluded.
